mentions.name: Stravaeger
mentions.description: A video game blending Valheim-style survival adventure with Ultima IV, playable as a demo in the browser on mobile and desktop and planned for a Steam release. It is built entirely in vanilla JavaScript, HTML and CSS with no third-party game engine, build system, or AI, and only a couple of external dependencies such as networking libraries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a video game. It's part Valheim, part Ultima IV:

https://stravaeger.com/

You can play the demo in the browser now (mobile as well as desktop), but I'll be packaging it up for Steam soon.
mentions.author: jasonkester
